Renamed. ; ;- function red_prefilterfit, par, xl = xl, yl = yl, spectrum = spectrum, lambda = lambda, pref=pref, w=w lambda1 = lambda - pref xl1 = (xl - pref)*par[7] y1 = interpol(yl, xl1+par[1], lambda1) prefc = red_prefilter(par, lambda, pref) return, (spectrum - (y1 * prefc)) * w end
